title: Record one three-entry n=8 parity prefix at 3/2 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

For the `n = 8` symbol `(1, 1/4, 1/8, 1/8, 0, 0, 0, 0)`, every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest is `3/2`. The right shear alone is `347/256`. This is the three-entry step left open by #4705. The branch is from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. The schedule applies the right shear, then the even child, then the Schur child, then the left shear, and repeats that order inside every child. There are 22 factors and 21 proper prefixes. The quotient is `(1/4, 3/32, -3/256, 3/2048)`. The first prefix's bottom row sums to `1 + 1/4 + 3/32 + 3/256 = 347/256`. The next nontrivial factor is the even child's right shear, with entry `1/8`. From there, the other 20 proper prefixes have infinity norm `3/2`. The product of the 22 factors equals the even/odd reordering of the Toeplitz matrix.

`347/256 < 3/2 < 9/4`. Adding the third tail entry lowers the first shear from the two-entry value `731/512` to `347/256` and still leaves every proper prefix under the one-level cap. The even child is `(1, 1/8, 0, 0)`. The Schur child is `(1, 1/16, -7/128, -9/1024)`. Eight nontrivial factors sit in the proper prefixes.

This is one symbol. It does not bound every tail of `l1` at most `1/2`, the generator-shear compiler, the completed Gaussian stage, or the dyadic `p^100` normalizer. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_THREE_ENTRY` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetches at 2026-10-22T16:57:31Z, 2026-10-22T16:59:44Z, and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T16:59:57Z were that commit. The pinned blobs of `certificates/selected-result.json` (`c35482cd9035843b15a634cc8276a7e1e40e8395`), `GAUSSIAN.md` (`adfb28c93e6b06178c901caaac39ede41a9e541b`), and `vendor/SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ.md` (`bc4349b2daea548ffa09e1f38a31f1df86b0b7be`) were unchanged. κ remains `60403/20000000`.
